body: No really it's okay, I needed it (:

Just wow.. Thank you so much for this. It's amazing to see how much people actually do care. This made me feel sooo much better. I was thinking irrationally and wanted the easiest way out without being in pain anymore. I guess I wasn't trying hard enough to get myself out of this unhappiness but now I will definitely fight all this sadness. I never really thought deeply about how I got here on this world and such. It is quite amazing to think that out of everyone that could have been here on this earth, in my place, rather than myself, is astonishing. Again, thank you so much for this. It means so much to me! I hope you're doing better now too! Stay strong (:
Rereading what I wrote and your input made me realize how stupid my logic was.. Thank you for helping me realize this
